title: Paradise Canyon-Private Event Venue-Estate 1&3
description: Welcome to Paradise Canyon–Estate 1&3, your desert wonderland on 45 acres of breathtaking Tonto National Forest. Lounge by infinity pools, soak in the spa, or toast marshmallows around fire pits under a star-studded sky. Challenge friends on the bocce ball court or putting green, whip up feasts in chef’s kitchens, and relax in luxurious en-suite bedrooms. Adventure is minutes away—try your swing at We-Ko-Pa Golf, catch a show at the casino, explore Saguaro Lake, or hike scenic desert trails.
amenities: 65 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, Roku
Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, wardrobe, and dresser
Free driveway parking on premises – 11 spaces
Housekeeping available from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, every day - available at extra cost
Pack ’n play/Travel crib - available upon request
Paid standalone high chair - available upon request
Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, lap pool
